# validate-every-boundary

HTTP, files, webhooks, config, model output, retrieved text, and tool results are untrusted until validated.

**When:** Handlers, adapters, MCP tools, prompts, or any ingress of foreign data.

**Why:** Types disappear at runtime and external systems fail outside the happy path.

**Do not:** Trust provider shapes, agent output, or cached snapshots without checks.

Cite this principle by id when it changed a decision. Keep the citation specific.
